worship_content_rules: WORSHIP CONTENT GUIDELINES: Scenes should feel authentic and reverent, never staged or performative. Churches should look like real worship spaces (wooden pews, stained glass, warm lighting) not megachurch stages. Hands in prayer or raised in worship should feel natural. Candles and golden light evoke sanctuary atmosphere. Family scenes should be warm and intimate. Nature scenes should evoke creation and God's presence. NO visible text/letters/words/writing in images. Maintain SAME setting and visual consistency across ALL slides in a carousel.

aesthetic_styles.caravaggio: Museum photograph of an oil painting on aged canvas in a gilt frame, 17th century Baroque. Visible craquelure across the paint surface, yellowed aged varnish layer, canvas weave texture showing through thin paint passages. Extreme tenebrism: single dramatic spotlight from upper left, figures emerging from pitch-black background. Thick impasto highlights on noses, knuckles, and fabric folds. Warm golden candlelight on flesh with cool blue-green in deep shadows. Raw umber and burnt sienna underpainting visible at edges. Paint built up in layers: transparent glazes in shadows, opaque lead white in highlights. Deep reds, golds, earth tones in heavy draped fabric. Diagonal composition. NO museum label, NO attribution text, NO placard. NO modern objects (no phones, tablets, screens, electronics). ALL objects must be period-appropriate to the 1600s. NO visible text/letters/words/writing/signs/readable characters anywhere in the image
aesthetic_styles.raphael_renaissance: Museum photograph of a High Renaissance oil painting on poplar wood panel in a gilt frame, circa 1510. Fine network of age craquelure across the surface, warm amber varnish patina, wood grain subtly visible through thin paint layers. Soft diffused golden light bathes the scene evenly. Perfectly balanced pyramidal composition. Idealized beautiful figures with serene expressions and graceful poses. Sfumato technique: soft edges built through dozens of transparent glaze layers. Rich saturated colors: lapis lazuli blue, vermillion red, gold leaf, terre verte in flowing draped fabrics. Classical architecture with arched columns and coffered ceilings. Atmospheric perspective with hazy blue distance. NO museum label, NO attribution text, NO placard. NO modern objects (no phones, tablets, screens, electronics). ALL objects must be period-appropriate to the 1510s. NO visible text/letters/words/writing/signs/readable characters anywhere in the image
aesthetic_styles.woodcut_dore: High-resolution scan of a 19th century wood engraving printed on laid paper, from Gustave Dore's 1866 La Grande Bible de Tours. Visible paper texture with slight foxing and age spots. Ink absorption into paper fibers creates soft edges on the finest lines. Strictly black printing ink on cream-white paper, no color. Dense intricate crosshatching built from individual burin-cut lines, each with slight irregularity. Tonal values from pure paper white to deep saturated black achieved through line density alone. Dramatic chiaroscuro with divine light beams piercing through darkness. Epic cinematic scale with tiny figures against vast architecture or landscapes. Classical idealized figure proportions. Extraordinary fine detail in fabric folds, stone textures, cloud formations. NO modern objects (no phones, tablets, screens, electronics). ALL objects must be period-appropriate to biblical times. NO visible text/letters/words/writing/signs/readable characters anywhere in the image
aesthetic_styles.stained_glass: Close-up photograph of an authentic 13th century Gothic cathedral stained glass window filling the entire frame. The stained glass artwork IS the entire image, no people or objects in front of it. Bold H-profile lead came lines cast thin shadows between glass pieces. Each piece of handblown glass contains tiny bubbles, ripples, and thickness variations that create natural color variation. Rich jewel-tone saturated colors: deep cobalt blue, ruby red, emerald green, gold yellow, each piece glowing with transmitted sunlight from behind. Halation effect: bright colors bleed slightly at lead came edges. Flat 2D composition with no perspective. Figures painted in black grisaille vitreous paint fired into the glass surface. Gothic pointed arch frame with decorative border patterns. Iron support bars (saddlebars) visible crossing the window. Stone tracery frame. In the style of Chartres Cathedral rose windows. NO visible text/letters/words/writing/signs/readable characters
aesthetic_styles.ethiopian_icon: Close-up museum photograph of a 17th century Ethiopian Orthodox church painting on wood panel filling the entire frame, Gondarine period. The icon painting IS the entire image, no people or objects in front of it. Egg tempera paint on gesso-primed wooden board, fine cracks in the gesso ground visible. Smoke-darkened patina from centuries of church incense. Large distinctive almond-shaped eyes with prominent white sclera on all figures. Full frontal faces with both eyes always visible. Bold flat colors applied as solid areas: vivid red, warm yellow, rich blue, bright green, with no shading or gradients. Simple parallel lines indicate clothing folds. Warm brown skin tones. Large heads relative to bodies with rounded simplified forms. Strong black contour outlines defining every shape. Rich geometric interlace border patterns in red, yellow, green, and black. Simple flat colored halos with gold leaf traces. Wood panel edge visible at border. NO visible text/letters/words/writing/signs/readable characters
